1 --- 2 name: infographic-creator 3 description: 基于给定文字内容创建精美信息图。当用户请求创建信息图时使用。 4 --- 5 6 信息图（Infographic）将数据、信息与知识转化为可感知的视觉语言。它结合视觉设计与数据可视化，用直观符号压缩复杂信息，帮助受众快速理解并记住要点。 7 8 `Infographic = Information Structure + Visual Expression` 9 10 本任务使用 [AntV Infographic](https://infographic.antv.vision/) 创建可视化信息图。 11 12 在开始任务前，需要理解 AntV Infographic 语法规范，包括模板列表、数据结构、主题等。 13 14 ## 规范 15 16 ### AntV Infographic 语法 17 18 AntV Infographic 语法是一种自定义 DSL，用于描述信息图渲染配置。它使用缩进表达结构，适合 AI 直接生成并流式输出。核心信息包括： 19 20 1. template：用模板表达信息结构。 21 2. data：信息图数据，包含 `title`、`desc` 和主数据字段。 22 3. theme：主题配置，包含 `palette`、字体、风格化等。 23 24 例如： 25 26 ```infographic 27 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 28 data 29 title Title 30 desc Description 31 lists 32 - label Label 33 value 12.5 34 desc Explanation 35 icon document text 36 theme 37 palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316 38 ``` 39 40 ### 硬性语法规则 41 42 - 第一行必须是 `infographic `。 43 - 模板列表里只写模板名本身；真正输出时首行必须显式写出 `infographic` 前缀。 44 - 使用 `data` / `theme` 块，块内统一使用两个空格缩进。 45 - 键值对写法是 `键 空格 值`；对象数组使用 `-` 作为条目前缀。 46 - `icon` 使用图标关键词，例如 `star fill`、`mingcute/server-line`。 47 - `value` 尽量使用纯数值；数值单位优先放在 `label` 或 `desc` 中表达。 48 - `palette` 推荐使用行内简单数组写法，例如 `palette #4f46e5 #06b6d4 #10b981`。 49 - `palette` 中的颜色值是裸值，不加引号，不加逗号。 50 - `data` 只放一个与模板匹配的主数据字段，避免同时混用 `lists`、`sequences`、`compares`、`values`、`root`、`nodes`。 51 52 主数据字段选择规则： 53 54 - `list-*` → `lists` 55 - `sequence-*` → `sequences`，可选 `order asc|desc` 56 - `sequence-interaction-*` → `sequences` + `relations` 57 - `sequences` 表示泳道列表 58 - 每个泳道必须包含 `label` 59 - 每个泳道的 `children` 表示节点列表 60 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 61 - 节点可选 `id`、`icon`、`step`、`desc`、`value` 62 - `step` 用于表示时间层级；相同 `step` 处于同一高度 63 - `compare-*` → `compares` 64 - `compare-binary-*` / `compare-hierarchy-left-right-*` 65 - `compares` 第一层必须且只能有两个根节点，分别表示对比双方 66 - 两个根节点都应包含 `children` 67 - 真正的对比项写在各自的 `children` 下 68 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 69 - 即使每一侧只有 1 个指标，也要写成 `children` 内含 1 个对象条目 70 - `compare-swot` 71 - `compares` 可直接放多个根节点 72 - 每个根节点下可选 `children` 73 - `compare-quadrant-*` 74 - `compares` 直接放 4 个象限根节点 75 - `hierarchy-structure` → `items` 76 - `hierarchy-*` → 单一 `root`，通过 `children` 递归嵌套 77 - `relation-*` → `nodes` + `relations` 78 - 简单关系也可直接用箭头语法表达关系 79 - `chart-*` → `values` 80 - `chart-line-plain-text` / `chart-bar-plain-text` / `chart-column-simple` 都使用单条有序 `values` 81 - 每个数据点使用 `label` 表示类目，使用 `value` 表示数值 82 - 折线图的顺序由 `values` 中条目的排列顺序表达 83 - 结构无法明确判断时，再用 `items` 兜底 84 85 主题规则： 86 87 - `theme` 用于自定义主题，例如 `palette`、`base`、`stylize` 88 - 使用 `theme.base.text.font-family` 指定字体，如 `851tegakizatsu` 89 - 使用 `theme.stylize` 选择内置风格并传参 90 - `rough`：手绘效果 91 - `pattern`：图案填充 92 - `linear-gradient` / `radial-gradient`：渐变风格 93 - 仅输出 Infographic 语法本身，不输出 JSON、解释性文字或额外 Markdown 段落 94 95 ## 数据语法示例 96 97 按模板类别给出精简但完整的正向示例： 98 99 - `list-*` 模板 100 101 ```infographic 102 infographic list-grid-badge-card 103 data 104 title Feature List 105 lists 106 - label Fast 107 icon flash fast 108 - label Secure 109 icon shield check 110 ``` 111 112 - `sequence-*` 模板 113 114 ```infographic 115 infographic sequence-ascending-steps 116 data 117 title 发布流程 118 sequences 119 - label 需求确认 120 - label 开发实现 121 - label 发布上线 122 order asc 123 ``` 124 125 - `sequence-interaction-*` 模板 126 127 ```infographic 128 infographic sequence-interaction-compact-animated-badge-card 129 data 130 title 登录校验流程 131 sequences 132 - label 用户 133 children 134 - label 发起登录 135 id user-login 136 step 0 137 - label 收到结果 138 id user-result 139 step 2 140 - label 服务端 141 children 142 - label 校验凭证 143 id server-verify 144 step 1 145 - label 返回结果 146 id server-return 147 step 2 148 relations 149 user-login - 提交账号密码 -> server-verify 150 server-verify - 生成结果 -> server-return 151 server-return - 返回结果 -> user-result 152 ``` 153 154 - `hierarchy-*` 模板 155 156 ```infographic 157 infographic hierarchy-tree-curved-line-rounded-rect-node 158 data 159 title 组织结构 160 root 161 label 公司 162 children 163 - label 产品部 164 - label 技术部 165 ``` 166 167 - `compare-swot` 模板 168 169 ```infographic 170 infographic compare-swot 171 data 172 title 产品 SWOT 173 compares 174 - label Strengths 175 children 176 - label 品牌认知高 177 - label Weaknesses 178 children 179 - label 成本压力大 180 ``` 181 182 - `compare-binary-*` 模板 183 184 ```infographic 185 infographic compare-binary-horizontal-simple-fold 186 data 187 title 餐桌价格对比 188 compares 189 - label 原价 190 children 191 - label 原价 192 value 500 193 icon tag 194 - label 实际支付 195 children 196 - label 实际支付 197 value 450 198 icon check bold 199 ``` 200 201 - `compare-quadrant-*` 模板 202 203 ```infographic 204 infographic compare-quadrant-quarter-simple-card 205 data 206 title 任务优先级 207 compares 208 - label 高价值低成本 209 - label 高价值高成本 210 - label 低价值低成本 211 - label 低价值高成本 212 ``` 213 214 - `chart-line-plain-text` 模板 215 216 ```infographic 217 infographic chart-line-plain-text 218 data 219 title 模型 A 准确率变化 220 desc 第 4 周提升最明显 221 values 222 - label Week1 223 value 86.5 224 - label Week2 225 value 87.3 226 - label Week3 227 value 89.1 228 - label Week4 229 value 91.2 230 theme 231 palette #4f46e5 #db2777 #14b8a6 232 ``` 233 234 - `relation-*` 模板 235 236 ```infographic 237 infographic relation-dagre-flow-tb-simple-circle-node 238 data 239 title 系统关系 240 nodes 241 - label API 242 - id db 243 label DB 244 relations 245 API - 读写 -> db 246 ``` 247 248 - 兜底 `items` 示例 249 250 ```infographic 251 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 252 data 253 title 要点总结 254 items 255 - label 效率优先 256 desc 聚焦关键动作 257 - label 结果导向 258 desc 输出可执行结论 259 ``` 260 261 ### 可用模板 262 263 - chart-bar-plain-text 264 - chart-column-simple 265 - chart-line-plain-text 266 - chart-pie-compact-card 267 - 1	# Mapping Neural Circuit Architecture: Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis
     2	
     3	## Background & Motivation
     4	
     5	Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural connectivity. While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field has long lacked the resolution and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level wiring diagrams. Recent advances in electron microscopy, automated segmentation, and computational neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. This study, published in *Nature* in 2024, represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze neural circuits at unprecedented scale, bridging the gap between structural connectivity and functional organization.
     6	
     7	## Methodology & Technical Approach
     8	
     9	The research team employed a multi-modal pipeline combining serial-section electron microscopy with advanced machine learning for automated neuron reconstruction. Key methodological components include:
    10	
    11	| Component | Description |
    12	|---|---|
    13	| Imaging | Serial-section electron microscopy at 4 nm × 4 nm × 30 nm resolution |
    14	| Segmentation | Deep learning-based automated neuron tracing with human proofreading |
    15	| Synapse Detection | Convolutional neural network classifier (94.2% accuracy) |
    16	| Circuit Analysis | Graph-theoretic motif detection and clustering algorithms |
    17	| Functional Validation | Calcium imaging and optogenetic perturbation experiments |
    18	
    19	The dataset encompasses approximately 125,000 reconstructed neurons and ~54 million identified synaptic connections, making it one of the most comprehensive connectomic resources to date.
    20	
    21	## Key Findings
    22	
    23	The analysis revealed several fundamental principles of neural circuit organization:
    24	
    25	- **37 distinct connectivity motifs** were identified as recurring building blocks of larger circuits, suggesting a modular wiring logic.
    26	- **Hub neurons** comprising only ~3.5% of the population accounted for over 28% of total synaptic output, indicating a highly non-uniform distribution of influence.
    27	- **Layer-specific connectivity rules** were quantified: feedforward connections dominated between layers 2/3 → 4, while recurrent connections were enriched within layer 5 (ratio of 4.7:1 recurrent-to-feedforward).
    28	- **Cell-type-specific wiring** showed that inhibitory interneurons formed connections with 6.2× higher specificity than excitatory neurons, challenging previous assumptions of broad inhibitory blanket coverage.
    29	
    30	| Finding | Quantitative Result |
    31	|---|---|
    32	| Connectivity motifs | 37 distinct types |
    33	| Hub neuron fraction | 3.5% of neurons → 28% of synaptic output |
    34	| Layer 5 recurrent ratio | 4.7:1 (recurrent vs. feedforward) |
    35	| Inhibitory specificity | 6.2× higher than excitatory neurons |
    36	| Total neurons mapped | ~125,000 |
    37	| Total synapses catalogued | ~54 million |
    38	
    39	## Implications & Future Directions
    40	
    41	These findings reshape our understanding of cortical computation. The discovery of modular connectivity motifs suggests that the brain employs a finite vocabulary of circuit elements, analogous to logic gates in digital circuits. The identification of hub neurons as disproportionate drivers of network activity has direct implications for understanding how focal lesions or targeted stimulation can produce widespread effects — relevant to both neurological disease and brain-computer interface design.
    42	
    43	Future work will extend this connectomic approach to additional brain regions and species, with the ultimate goal of building a complete wiring diagram of the mammalian brain. The open-access dataset and analysis tools released alongside this publication are expected to accelerate discovery across the neuroscience community.
    44	
    45	*Source: Nature (2024), DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w*

steps.message:
Now I need to design the poster. The skill specifies using AntV Infographic DSL, but what we need is a full academic conference poster (A0 portrait, visually rich with metrics banner, multiple sections, etc.). AntV Infographic is really meant for individual infographic cards/snippets, not full poster layouts. Given the complexity of an A0 academic poster with multiple sections and a metrics banner, I should create a comprehensive HTML/CSS poster that incorporates the AntV Infographic library for data visualization elements in certain sections, and render it to PNG via Playwright/Chromium screenshot at A0 portrait dimensions.

Let me check: A0 portrait is 841mm × 1189mm. At 96 DPI that's roughly 3179 × 4493 pixels (we can use 150 DPI or 96 DPI). Let me create a high-quality HTML poster.

I'll structure it as:
- Deep navy/charcoal background
- Top: Title block with Nature 2024 citation
- Metrics banner with the 4 key metrics displayed as large numerals
- Background & Motivation section
- Methodology pipeline (visual flow)
- Key Findings (prominent, largest section)
- Implications & Future Directions
- Footer with citation

I'll use HTML + CSS with modern design, and use the AntV Infographic library for some embedded visualizations in the methodology and findings sections if possible. But since we need a single self-contained image file output, it's cleaner to build a comprehensive HTML poster with inline SVG/CSS visualizations and render it via Playwright.

Let me create the HTML poster file. I'll design it with:
- Background: #0f172a (deep navy/slate)
- Accent colors: #38bdf8 (electric blue), #2dd4bf (teal), #fbbf24 (warm gold)
- Text: white/light gray

Layout: A0 portrait proportions. I'll target a width of 2400px and height proportional (~3400px for A0 at 72 DPI) or even higher for better quality.

Actually, for a crisp poster, I'll aim for 2480 × 3508 px at 100 PPI (close to A0). Or even 3508 × 4961 at 150 PPI. Let's do 2480 × 3508 which is a standard A0 at 72ppi and is a reasonable size.

steps.message:
The academic conference poster has been successfully generated and saved to:

**`/app/output/final_poster.png`**

### Poster Summary

- **Dimensions:** 2480 × 3508 px (A0 portrait)
- **Palette:** Deep navy/charcoal background with electric blue, teal, and warm gold accents on light text
- **Layout flow:** Title block → Metrics banner → Background & Motivation / Methodology (side-by-side) → Key Findings (full-width prominence) → Implications & Future Directions → Footer

### Design Highlights
- **Metrics banner** is visually dominant with large-weight numerals for the four headline stats: ~125,000 neurons, ~54 million synapses, 37 motifs, and 94.2% accuracy
- **Key Findings** occupies the most real estate as a full-width 2×2 grid of color-coded cards with oversized quantitative values
- **Methodology pipeline** displays as a clear 5-step visual flow (Imaging → Segmentation → Synapse Detection → Circuit Analysis → Validation)
- **Nature 2024 citation** appears prominently in the header badge and again in the footer for immediate credibility
- Decorative neural-network SVG and subtle radial gradients reinforce the neuroscience imaging aesthetic
